name: What prep should be done before interior wall painting?
description: Proper prep usually includes cleaning, patching holes, caulking gaps, sanding rough spots, and priming repaired areas before finish coats.

mainEntity.name: What prep should be done before interior wall painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small wall repairs, sanding, caulking, and priming usually come before any finish coats. For a good result, the surface should be clean, dry, and patched so the paint can bond evenly.
